environment.postgres: 18.6; new disposable loopback soundwave_ci_creator_20261110 database, generated schemas and restore databases
environment.redis: 7.4.12; dedicated loopback test container with randomized namespaces
environment.browser: Local headless Google Chrome via Playwright 1.64.1 on Apple Silicon macOS

roleModel.staffRole: users.platform_role: listener(default)/moderator/admin; staff only for registered accounts
roleModel.creatorPermission: Derived from current active creator_profiles row; keyed to stable registered account UUID, independent of password/Google provider
roleModel.onboarding: Explicit registered-only automatic activation; duplicate calls preserve existing fields. No email-verification prerequisite for this private identity-only capability. No uploads, publishing or moderation permission is granted.
roleModel.lifecycle: active/inactive/suspended; inactive self-reactivates, suspended cannot edit/deactivate/reactivate; only trusted operator restores suspension
roleModel.staffProvisioning: Explicit database environment and --confirm-operator CLI, never HTTP; no first-user/admin signup shortcut
roleModel.authorization: Session-derived ID, current DB role/status, active creator AND exact story owner; no staff cross-creator edit bypass; future writes must authorize and mutate inside one outer transaction
